headline: Saudi PIF's $55 billion EA deal gets EU approval under subsidy rules
summary: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund and a ‌group of investors have gained EU approval ‌for their $55 billion acquisition of video game developer Electronic Arts ​under the bloc's subsidy rules, a European Commission filing showed on Friday.  In a regulatory filing on Thursday, Electronic Arts said it had received all regulatory ‌approvals as of ⁠July 30 and that it expects to close the deal on August 4.  The ⁠deal secured a green light under EU merger rules last week, but the review under the ​Foreign Subsidies ​Regulation (FSR) was seen ​as the bigger hurdle.
